On December 30, 2021, the Marshall Fire ignited in Boulder County, Colorado, driven by sustained winds of 70--100+ mph from the west. Fueled primarily by dry grasslands, the fire burned roughly 6,000 acres and destroyed over 1,000 structures in the communities of Louisville and Superior, making it the most destructive wildfire in Colorado history.

This tutorial builds a simplified reconstruction using synthetic data on a reduced grid. The final product is an animated GIF showing terrain contours, burned area, building status, fire perimeter, and wind particles.

```{julia}
using Elmfire
using Plots
using Random

Random.seed!(2021)
```

## Setup: Grid & Synthetic Data

We use a 200x120 grid at 30 m (≈98.4 ft) per cell, covering roughly 6 km x 3.6 km — enough to capture the fire's west-to-east run.

```{julia}
ncols, nrows = 200, 120
cellsize = 98.4  # 30 m in feet

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Elevation: gentle west-high to east-low slope with noise
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------#
elevation = zeros(Float64, ncols, nrows)
for ix in 1:ncols, iy in 1:nrows
    # ~80 m drop west to east (1700 m to 1620 m), with minor noise
    elevation[ix, iy] = 1700.0 - 80.0 * (ix - 1) / (ncols - 1) +
        2.0 * sin(ix / 15.0) * cos(iy / 12.0)
end

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Slope and aspect from finite differences
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------#
slope = zeros(Float64, ncols, nrows)
aspect = zeros(Float64, ncols, nrows)
for ix in 2:ncols-1, iy in 2:nrows-1
    dzdx = (elevation[ix+1, iy] - elevation[ix-1, iy]) / (2 * cellsize)
    dzdy = (elevation[ix, iy+1] - elevation[ix, iy-1]) / (2 * cellsize)
    slope[ix, iy] = atand(sqrt(dzdx^2 + dzdy^2))
    aspect[ix, iy] = mod(atand(dzdy, -dzdx), 360.0)
end

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Fuel map: grass with patches and non-burnable buildings
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------#
fuel_ids = fill(1, ncols, nrows)  # FBFM01: short grass

# Scatter some FBFM02 (timber with grass understory) patches
for _ in 1:40
    cx, cy = rand(20:180), rand(10:110)
    r = rand(3:8)
    for ix in max(1, cx-r):min(ncols, cx+r)
        for iy in max(1, cy-r):min(nrows, cy+r)
            if (ix - cx)^2 + (iy - cy)^2 <= r^2
                fuel_ids[ix, iy] = 2
            end
        end
    end
end

# Scatter some non-burnable cells (roads, rock)
for _ in 1:20
    cx, cy = rand(1:ncols), rand(1:nrows)
    for ix in max(1, cx-1):min(ncols, cx+1)
        for iy in max(1, cy-1):min(nrows, cy+1)
            fuel_ids[ix, iy] = 256  # FUEL_MODEL_NONBURNABLE
        end
    end
end

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------#
# Buildings: two clusters in eastern portion (Louisville / Superior)
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------#
building_x = Int[]
building_y = Int[]

# Cluster 1: "Louisville" — centered around (150, 60)
for _ in 1:160
    bx = clamp(round(Int, 150 + 15 * randn()), 125, 175)
    by = clamp(round(Int, 60 + 12 * randn()), 35, 85)
    push!(building_x, bx)
    push!(building_y, by)
end

# Cluster 2: "Superior" — centered around (160, 35)
for _ in 1:140
    bx = clamp(round(Int, 160 + 12 * randn()), 135, 185)
    by = clamp(round(Int, 35 + 10 * randn()), 15, 55)
    push!(building_x, bx)
    push!(building_y, by)
end

println("Grid: $(ncols) x $(nrows) cells ($(round(ncols * 30 / 1000, digits=1)) km x $(round(nrows * 30 / 1000, digits=1)) km)")
println("Buildings: $(length(building_x))")
```

### Real Fire Perimeter

We embed a simplified 68-vertex outline of the NIFC-reported final Marshall Fire perimeter (source: [WFIGS Interagency Fire Perimeters](https://data-nifc.opendata.arcgis.com/datasets/nifc::wfigs-interagency-fire-perimeters/about)). The real fire covered a larger area (~8.7 km x 6.3 km) than our synthetic grid (6 km x 3.6 km), so we apply an affine mapping from the perimeter's geographic bounding box to the grid extents. The cyan dashed overlay is an **approximate visual reference**, not a georeferenced projection.

```{julia}

# Affine mapping: real bounding box → grid coordinates
lon_min, lon_max = extrema(marshall_lons)
lat_min, lat_max = extrema(marshall_lats)
real_perim_col = [(lon - lon_min) / (lon_max - lon_min) * ncols for lon in marshall_lons]
real_perim_row = [(lat - lat_min) / (lat_max - lat_min) * nrows for lat in marshall_lats]

println("Real perimeter: $(length(marshall_lons)) vertices mapped to grid")
```

## Static Overview

Four-panel summary of the simulation inputs.

```{julia}
p1 = contourf(1:ncols, 1:nrows, elevation',
    title = "Elevation (m)", color = :terrain,
    xlabel = "col", ylabel = "row", aspect_ratio = :equal,
    linewidth = 0.3, levels = 12)

p2 = heatmap(fuel_ids',
    title = "Fuel Types", color = cgrad([:lightgreen, :darkgreen, :gray]),
    aspect_ratio = :equal, colorbar = false,
    xlabel = "col", ylabel = "row")

p3 = scatter(building_x, building_y,
    title = "Building Locations",
    marker = :square, markersize = 1.5, markerstrokewidth = 0,
    color = :steelblue, legend = false,
    xlims = (1, ncols), ylims = (1, nrows),
    aspect_ratio = :equal,
    xlabel = "col", ylabel = "row")
plot!(p3, real_perim_col, real_perim_row,
    color = :cyan, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1.5, label = false)

p4 = quiver([100], [60], quiver = ([30], [0]),
    title = "Wind: 70 mph from W",
    xlims = (1, ncols), ylims = (1, nrows),
    aspect_ratio = :equal, legend = false,
    linewidth = 3, color = :black,
    xlabel = "col", ylabel = "row")
annotate!(p4, 115, 65, text("→ 70 mph", 10, :left))

plot(p1, p2, p3, p4, layout = (2, 2), size = (900, 600))
```

## Run Simulation with Snapshots

We run 360 minutes (6 hours) in 40 steps, capturing the burned state at each step.

```{julia}
fuel_table = create_standard_fuel_table(Float64)

# Marshall Fire weather: extreme west wind, very dry fuels
weather = ConstantWeather{Float64}(
    wind_speed_mph = 70.0,
    wind_direction = 270.0,  # From west
    M1 = 0.03,
    M10 = 0.05,
    M100 = 0.08,
    MLH = 0.30,
    MLW = 0.60
)

state = FireState{Float64}(ncols, nrows, cellsize)

# Ignite near the western edge (approximate origin of Marshall Fire)
ignite!(state, 15, 60, 0.0)

# Capture snapshots
n_frames = 40
dt_frame = 360.0 / n_frames  # 9 min per frame
frames_burned = [copy(state.burned)]
frames_toa = [copy(state.time_of_arrival)]
frame_times = [0.0]

for i in 1:n_frames
    t_start = (i - 1) * dt_frame
    t_stop = i * dt_frame
    simulate!(state, fuel_ids, fuel_table, weather,
        slope, aspect, t_start, t_stop;
        dt_initial = 0.5,
        dampening = SpreadRateDampeningConfig{Float64}(WIND_SPEED_CAP))
    push!(frames_burned, copy(state.burned))
    push!(frames_toa, copy(state.time_of_arrival))
    push!(frame_times, t_stop)
end

println("Simulation complete: $(length(frames_burned)) frames captured")
println("Burned area: $(round(get_burned_area_acres(state), digits=0)) acres")
```

## Animated Multi-Layer Plot

Six visual layers per frame: terrain contours, burned area (time-of-arrival), buildings (standing vs destroyed), simulated fire perimeter, the NIFC-reported real fire perimeter (cyan dashed line), and wind particles.

```{julia}
# Pre-compute wind particles (advected west→east across frames)
n_particles = 80
wx = rand(1:ncols, n_particles)  # x positions
wy = rand(1:nrows, n_particles)  # y positions

anim = @animate for (fi, t) in enumerate(frame_times)
    burned = frames_burned[fi]
    toa = copy(frames_toa[fi])
    toa[toa .< 0] .= NaN

    # Layer 1: terrain contours (base)
    p = contour(1:ncols, 1:nrows, elevation',
        color = :grays, linewidth = 0.4, levels = 10,
        aspect_ratio = :equal, colorbar = false,
        xlims = (1, ncols), ylims = (1, nrows),
        title = "Marshall Fire — t = $(round(Int, t)) min",
        xlabel = "col", ylabel = "row",
        size = (800, 500), legend = :topright)

    # Layer 2: burned area (time-of-arrival heatmap)
    burn_x, burn_y, burn_c = Int[], Int[], Float64[]
    for ix in 1:ncols, iy in 1:nrows
        if burned[ix, iy]
            push!(burn_x, ix)
            push!(burn_y, iy)
            push!(burn_c, isnan(toa[ix, iy]) ? 0.0 : toa[ix, iy])
        end
    end
    if !isempty(burn_x)
        scatter!(p, burn_x, burn_y,
            marker = :square, markersize = 2.5, markerstrokewidth = 0,
            zcolor = burn_c, color = :YlOrRd, clims = (0, 360),
            alpha = 0.7, label = false, colorbar_title = "min")
    end

    # Layer 3: buildings (steelblue = standing, red = destroyed)
    for k in eachindex(building_x)
        bx, by = building_x[k], building_y[k]
        destroyed = 1 <= bx <= ncols && 1 <= by <= nrows && burned[bx, by]
        scatter!(p, [bx], [by],
            marker = :square, markersize = 2, markerstrokewidth = 0,
            color = destroyed ? :red : :steelblue,
            label = false)
    end

    # Layer 4: fire perimeter
    perim_x, perim_y = Int[], Int[]
    for ix in 1:ncols, iy in 1:nrows
        if burned[ix, iy]
            is_edge = false
            for (dx, dy) in ((1,0), (-1,0), (0,1), (0,-1))
                nx, ny = ix + dx, iy + dy
                if nx < 1 || nx > ncols || ny < 1 || ny > nrows || !burned[nx, ny]
                    is_edge = true
                    break
                end
            end
            if is_edge
                push!(perim_x, ix)
                push!(perim_y, iy)
            end
        end
    end
    if !isempty(perim_x)
        scatter!(p, perim_x, perim_y,
            marker = :circle, markersize = 1.5, markerstrokewidth = 0,
            color = :orangered, alpha = 0.9, label = false)
    end

    # Layer 5: real fire perimeter (NIFC)
    plot!(p, real_perim_col, real_perim_row,
        color = :cyan, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1.5, label = false)

    # Layer 6: wind particles (advected eastward)
    for k in eachindex(wx)
        wx[k] += rand(3:6)
        wy[k] += rand(-1:1)
        if wx[k] > ncols
            wx[k] = rand(1:5)
            wy[k] = rand(1:nrows)
        end
        wy[k] = clamp(wy[k], 1, nrows)
    end
    scatter!(p, wx, wy,
        marker = :circle, markersize = 1, markerstrokewidth = 0,
        color = :white, alpha = 0.6, label = false)

    # Legend entries (invisible scatter for labels)
    scatter!(p, [NaN], [NaN], color = :steelblue, marker = :square, label = "Standing")
    scatter!(p, [NaN], [NaN], color = :red, marker = :square, label = "Destroyed")
    scatter!(p, [NaN], [NaN], color = :orangered, marker = :circle, markersize = 2, label = "Perimeter")
    plot!(p, [NaN], [NaN], color = :cyan, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1.5, label = "Real perimeter")

    p
end

gif(anim, fps = 4)
```

## Summary Statistics

```{julia}
burned_acres = round(get_burned_area_acres(state), digits=0)
final_burned = frames_burned[end]
n_destroyed = count(k -> begin
    bx, by = building_x[k], building_y[k]
    1 <= bx <= ncols && 1 <= by <= nrows && final_burned[bx, by]
end, eachindex(building_x))

println("=" ^ 50)
println("Marshall Fire Simulation Summary")
println("=" ^ 50)
println("  Grid:             $(ncols) x $(nrows) cells ($(round(ncols * 30 / 1000, digits=1)) km x $(round(nrows * 30 / 1000, digits=1)) km)")
println("  Cell size:        30 m ($(cellsize) ft)")
println("  Duration:         360 min (6 hours)")
println("  Wind:             70 mph from west")
println("  Burned area:      $(burned_acres) acres")
println("  Buildings:        $(length(building_x)) total")
println("  Destroyed:        $(n_destroyed) ($(round(100 * n_destroyed / length(building_x), digits=1))%)")
```

## Final State

Two-panel view of the final burned area with buildings and the time-of-arrival map.

```{julia}
# Panel 1: burned area with buildings
toa_final = copy(state.time_of_arrival)
toa_final[toa_final .< 0] .= NaN

p1 = heatmap(state.burned',
    title = "Final Burned Area",
    color = :YlOrRd, aspect_ratio = :equal,
    colorbar = false, xlabel = "col", ylabel = "row")

for k in eachindex(building_x)
    bx, by = building_x[k], building_y[k]
    destroyed = 1 <= bx <= ncols && 1 <= by <= nrows && final_burned[bx, by]
    scatter!(p1, [bx], [by],
        marker = :square, markersize = 2, markerstrokewidth = 0,
        color = destroyed ? :red : :steelblue, label = false)
end

# Overlay real perimeter on burned area panel
plot!(p1, real_perim_col, real_perim_row,
    color = :cyan, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1.5, label = "Real perimeter")

# Panel 2: time-of-arrival
p2 = heatmap(toa_final',
    title = "Time of Arrival (min)",
    color = :viridis, aspect_ratio = :equal,
    xlabel = "col", ylabel = "row")
plot!(p2, real_perim_col, real_perim_row,
    color = :cyan, linestyle = :dash, linewidth = 1.5, label = "Real perimeter")

plot(p1, p2, layout = (1, 2), size = (900, 400))
```
